review:
Eggs of Fortune is a five-line jewelled-egg slot with a 5,000x max win and the highest volatility rating Wazdan uses: Extreme. It's built around two Cash Out features in the base game, which give you two separate routes to bonus prizes on any spin.

Collector symbols and Countdown Boosters build up towards the Free Spins round, where the collected values pay out. Chance Level offers three settings – x2, x5 and x10 the bet – that raise the odds of features at a higher cost per spin. Wazdan lists a 96.12% RTP. With only five lines and an extreme rating, this is one for patient players; try plenty of demo spins first.
pros: Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
